notes: Authoritative record spec for the Altmer race (Phase 2, OFFER / active-patron gate). Modelled structurally on PDV_KhajiitRewardRecords.spec.json. Altmer is an OFFER race: rewards gate on IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible (active patron tier >= Seeker). Broad worship is the Orthodox STATE (R1), NOT a deity record. Altmer OWNS Magnus, Xarxes, and Syrabane (create:true); REUSES Auri-El (create:false) and the Orc-owned Trinimac record (create:false). Trinimac is a true Altmer focused path behind a hard high-orthodoxy gate: ThalmorAlignment >= 70 plus meaningful civilization-defense/enforcement signals. Syrabane is a true Altmer focused path starting narrow: warding, magical protection, apprentice/College aid, curse/disease warding, and anti-mage survival only. Phynaster is roster/flavor-only for Altmer V1: no PDV_Deity_Phynaster, no formal offer, and no reward family. ThalmorAlignment gates Trinimac access and modulates Trinimac gain/offer weight after access, but is pressure/access/interpretation, NOT a third boon track (R8). Daedric forks route through the existing 20C Daedric system (R6). T3 recognition is V1 Survey/status text only (non-voiced), per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). GetAltmerSummary explains Auri-El foundation, current standing, crisis state, Lorkhan pressure, ThalmorAlignment band, most recent orthodox/dawn favor, and curse posture in fiction-facing terms. Voiced NPC recognition is V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on boon families (R8 cap): (1) Auri-El foundation [broad Orthodox state reward + Auri-El focus], (2) ONE secondary focus (Magnus OR Trinimac OR Xarxes OR Syrabane, one active at a time) plus one active contextual favor family. Syrabane launch breadth stays protection/apprentice-only until implementation proof shows the narrow lane is too thin. ThalmorAlignment is pressure/access/interpretation, NOT a third boon track; for Trinimac it gates access and modulates gain/offer weight. Lorkhan/crisis is pressure, not a boon. Reward ceiling per ledger = Auri-El foundation + one secondary + one contextual favor family.

balanceInvariants.boonFamilyCap: 2 (Auri-El foundation + one secondary focus). ThalmorAlignment and crisis are NOT counted boon families.
balanceInvariants.broadLessThanFocused: Broad Orthodox caps at T2/Faithful and is suppressed when a patron is focused; focused 3-tier sets reach Champion.
balanceInvariants.oneAntiFarmPerAct: Each faucet act uses exactly ScoreRepeatableAction OR ConsumeDailyRepeatMultiplier, never both. Active-patron piety acts use ScoreRepeatableAction only.
balanceInvariants.magnitudeCeiling: Percentage-style effects follow the 2026-06-14 Requiem ceiling review (MagickaRateMult and ResistMagic can reach the documented T3 caps; DamageResist is armor points and exempt). Skill ActorValue bonuses are point bonuses, not percentages.
balanceInvariants.asciiOnly: All playerFacingText is ASCII-only (Auri-El written with hyphen-minus).
balanceInvariants.actorValuesValid: MagickaRateMult, ResistMagic, Alteration, Restoration, OneHanded, DamageResist are valid Skyrim ActorValue names.
balanceInvariants.deityIndex: Magnus/Xarxes/Syrabane use next-available (serial author-time assignment, collision-free); Auri-El reuses its existing index; Trinimac is reused create:false from Orc.
balanceInvariants.oneActiveFavorFamily: Only one contextual favor family is loud at a time (costing-manifest rule).

rulingCompliance.R1: Broad Orthodox is a STATE (PATRON_STATE_BROAD), not a deity. No PDV_Deity_Orthodox/Nine record created.
rulingCompliance.R2: Broad T1 editorId is the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Altmer_Orthodox_T1; broad T2 = PDV_Bless_Altmer_Orthodox_T2 (same stem).
rulingCompliance.R3: Focused sets named PDV_Bless_Altmer_<Patron>_T1/T2/T3 for AuriEl/Magnus/Trinimac/Xarxes/Syrabane; grant logic mirrors SyncKhajiitEmphasisRewards (one active focus; T1>=Seeker, T2>=Devoted, T3>=Champion).
rulingCompliance.R4: Auri-El is a SHARED record; Altmer references create:false and adds Stance_Altmer via --reconcile-shared-deity. Trinimac is shared from Orc owner (create:false) but Altmer treats it as NATIVE/focusable behind high-orthodoxy access.
rulingCompliance.R5: Only focusable patrons (Auri-El, Magnus, Trinimac, Xarxes, Syrabane) get/keep deity records. Trinimac reuses the Orc-owned shared record and does not create a new Altmer-owned QUST; Syrabane is Altmer-owned and protection-gated. Phynaster remains roster/flavor-only for Altmer V1 and is not authored.
rulingCompliance.R6: Daedric forks route through the existing 20C Daedric system; no new Daedric Prince records authored.
rulingCompliance.R7: Altmer is offer / active-patron: rewards gate on IsFirstTierRaceRewardEligible (patron tier >= Seeker).
rulingCompliance.R8: <=2 boon families; broad<focused; one anti-farm per act; magnitude ceiling ~12%; creed-loss medium/major only; ASCII-only text; Skyrim ActorValue names only; ThalmorAlignment is not a third boon track.
